production_note: Original generated mascot, banner and monochrome tray artwork retained unchanged. menu_bar_icon.method: Technical sharp export: trim transparent margins, resize within 32×32, center on transparent 36×36 canvas. Alpha eye/face holes retained; no opaque white pixels. macOS tray-icon renders at 18 logical points and applies template tint.
